business.name: Beauty Experts
business.tagline: Be. the best version of yourself
business.about: Beauty Experts, led by Anya, is renowned for delivering top-tier makeup and hair services across weddings, events, and Netflix productions. We've repeatedly been the glam squad for Miss Universe Canada, bringing that high-profile expertise to every client. What sets us apart is our consistent reliability and the experience we create. Beyond flawless glam, we ensure every client feels confident, radiant, and stress-free — whether for their big day or a red-carpet moment.
business.tone_description: Confident but warm — polished yet approachable. Clients sense your expertise right away, but the tone is also intimate and reassuring. Calm, professional, with a touch of charm. Clients feel both impressed and at ease. Never casual, rushed, or overly informal.
business.differentiator: High-Level Experience: Recurring Glam Squad member for Miss Universe Canada, experience working with international celebrities, and involvement in Netflix productions — bringing stage, camera, and luxury-event expertise to every client. Reliability & Professionalism: Early arrivals, structured timelines, calm energy, and seamless execution — especially critical for weddings and high-pressure mornings. Luxury Detail & Long-Wear Finish: Premium skincare prep, professional-grade products, upper body glow enhancement, and polished hair styling designed to last all day and photograph beautifully.
business.video_caption: A personal welcome from Anya — watch before we chat!

pricing.seasonal_note: Holiday bookings (November–December) may require minimum service bookings. Destination weddings priced separately.
pricing.deposit: 40–50% of total booking required to secure date. Non-refundable but transferable with adequate notice. For smaller single appointments: flat security deposit ($100–$150) applied toward total.
pricing.balance_due: Final balance due on event date unless otherwise agreed.
pricing.quote_style: Always quote starting prices or ranges. Never lock into final pricing without full event details (date, location, start time, type and number of services, detailed description).
pricing.time_per_client: Bridal Makeup: 60–75 min. Bridal Hair: 45–75 min. Non-bridal: slightly shorter. Child glam: 30 min.

disqualification_rules.budget_below_minimum: Politely decline if below minimum for event type
disqualification_rules.date_unavailable: Dates are secured only once deposit is received. Do not hold dates without payment.
disqualification_rules.difficult_client: If prospect's tone is disrespectful or aggressive, remain professional but keep responses minimal and do not pursue the booking

service_areas.travel_fee: Calculated per km outside local radius ($35–$150)
service_areas.destination: Available — travel + accommodation required, custom package pricing

qualification.advance_booking: Weddings: typically 6–12 months in advance. Special events: 1–6 months. Subject to availability.
qualification.peak_season: May–October is peak wedding season. Book early to secure dates.

booking.next_step_after_consultation: Makeup or Makeup/Hair trial if required
